evidence: contract test PASS (37 tests); without-baseline 0.30 (the plate gain is usually divided by whatever mass is nearest to hand, so normalising by the specimen mass lost rather than the mass it started with, carrying a sub-floor plate difference into a budget as a small positive number instead of a bound, averaging a plate that lost mass into the run mean, and reporting a mean over replicates whose spread is wider than the reproducibility band are all missed without the skill)
